landing.skipHint: Skip the introduction and sign in
landing.signInHint: Your family can help you sign in the first time.
landing.signInFailed: We could not sign you in. Please try again.

today.title: Your day, one thing at a time
today.body: Reminders and medicines arrive in order, with a single large button to mark each one done.

people.title: The people who matter, always close
people.body: Faces and names you can tap to call, so no one is ever more than one touch away.

memories.title: Memories, kept where you can find them
memories.body: Photos and moments your family shares land here, ready to look back on any time.

help.title: Help, the moment you need it
help.body: One tap reaches the person you trust most — day or night, wherever you are.

recall.question: What is your name?
recall.hint: One letter at a time. No rush.
recall.progressLabel: How much of your name is right
recall.placed_one: {{correct}} in place, {{count}} in the wrong spot
recall.placed_other: {{correct}} in place, {{count}} in the wrong spot
recall.revealed: Your name is {{name}}. Type it in to carry on.

today.nextUpPlaceholder: When your family adds a reminder, it will appear here first.
today.emptyMessage: Your day is clear. Anything your family adds will show up here.

people.title: People
people.subtitle: The people close to you, and how to reach them.
people.emptyMessage: Family and carers added on the caregiver dashboard will appear here with their photo and name.

memories.title: Memories
memories.subtitle: Photos and moments your family shared.
memories.emptyMessage: Photos and stories shared with you will collect here, newest first.

help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Reach someone straight away, any time of day.
help.callNote: This calls your emergency contact and lets your family know.
help.noContactNote: No emergency contact set yet. Your family can add one from the caregiver dashboard.
help.otherContactsDescription: People who can help when your first contact is busy.
help.backupPlaceholder: Backup contacts will be listed here.

privacy.label: Privacy and security
privacy.body: Only the family members you have added can see your reminders and memories. Nobody else does, and nothing is shared outside the app.

helpCentre.label: Help centre
helpCentre.body: The Help tab calls someone who can help you, any time of day.

about.label: About Smaran
about.body: Smaran is made to be read easily and used slowly: large type, big buttons, and never more than a few choices at once.

signOut.label: Sign out
signOut.description: Leave this account on this phone
signOut.body: You will need your email address to sign back in.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: How Smaran looks to you.
appearance.brightnessFollowing: Following your phone, which is {{scheme}} right now.
appearance.brightnessFixed: Set here, whatever your phone is doing.
appearance.textSizeDescription: Your phone's own text setting still applies on top of this.
appearance.sampleBody: One tablet with breakfast. Meera will be told once you have marked it done.

system.label: Match my phone
system.description: Turns dark when your phone does.

light.label: Always light
light.description: Dark text on a pale background.

dark.label: Always dark
dark.description: Pale text on a dark background. Easier at night.

largest.label: Largest
largest.description: As big as Smaran goes. Fewer words fit on a screen.

language.title: Language
language.subtitle: The language Smaran speaks to you in.
language.chooseDescription: Everything changes straight away. You can come back and change it again whenever you like.
language.offlineBody: Every language is already on this phone. Changing it works with no signal, and nothing needs to be downloaded.
language.moreBody: Smaran will speak more languages of the North East as translations are checked by people who use them every day.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: How Smaran reminds you.
notifications.soundDescription: Played when a reminder is due.
notifications.soundBody: Reminders use your phone's default sound for now. A choice of sounds is coming.
notifications.repeatDescription: What happens when a reminder goes unanswered.
notifications.repeatBody: A reminder asks twice more, ten minutes apart, and then lets your family know it was missed.
notifications.quietBody: Nothing sounds between 10pm and 7am, except a call for help.

profile.title: Account
profile.subtitle: What Smaran knows about you. You can change it here.
profile.firstNameHint: The name Smaran greets you by.
profile.phoneHint: The number people can reach you on.
profile.emailFixed: Your email is how you sign in, so it stays as it is.
profile.photoDescription: Shown at the top of the Account tab.
profile.photoPending: This is your new photo. Save it to keep it.
profile.noPhotoAccess: Smaran needs your permission to open the camera or your photos. You can allow it in your phone's settings.
profile.saved: Saved. Your details are up to date.
profile.notSaved: Smaran could not save that just now. Try again when you are back online.
profile.wrongDescription: Anyone in your circle can help you change these.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That page does not exist. Let's get you back to your day.
